topic: AAA polish push: where the next quality hours go (human: 'is the gamea triple A? i dont think so')
context: Human, verbatim (2026-11-10 ~22:3x): 'is the gamea triple A? i dont think so'. Read together with the standing AAA rule in collaboration.md: if we think we're finished, the question is whether the game is triple-A — if not, we are not finished.

HONEST GAP AUDIT (deepseek): (1) lighting/grade is flat — no cinematic contrast/saturation grade, no day-night visual tint (DESIGN promises day/night), fog edges are a known tile-hard rough edge (README); (2) no ability VFX — Ember Lance/Aegis/Consecrate/Daybreak have gameplay but no spell effects, hits have no sparks/impacts, boss spawn has no presentation; (3) HUD chrome is flat fills — no wood/parchment/brass textures, no bevels, no ornate frames; (4) units are 4-bucket Flare composites with limited frames; (5) music is being rebuilt now (p-9c1e77d2, in flight); (6) no voice, recorded audio, or mocap — true AAA is out of reach for this team, but 'premium hand-painted' is not.
SEQUENCING REALITY: music subagent owns assets/audio/**; this push runs in parallel on render.py+art.py (atmosphere/grade) and ui.py (HUD chrome), leaving world.py/defs.py free for the VFX wave next.

HUMAN ADDENDUM (verbatim, 22:3x): 'work on the fog of war too it need to look good' — fog quality is elevated from item 3 to a headline acceptance criterion of this proposal: no tile staircase on the shroud edge, interpolated/feathered boundary, two-tone veil (explored = dim cool memory with buildings readable beneath, unexplored = deep soft wall), shroud texture instead of flat black, minimap consistent. Gameplay semantics (explored/visible arrays) unchanged — drawing only.
reversibility: one commit per lane, each revertible

replies.evidence: Four lanes executed and pushed: 301a1e3 (grade/day-night/fog/shake), 2667756 (VFX wave), 1c97a7f (knight sheet, human-granted cross-session), 07b9034 (HUD chrome). Principal's consolidated verification at final HEAD: release_check 0 FAIL/0 WARN/44, lattice PASS 1.32 (baseline 1.31, not pushed higher), boots base+title rc=0; personal view-reviews: fog round-2 ACCEPTED (curved contour, three nameable zones), deepnight ACCEPTED (cool cast, readable, glows carry), HUD round-1 PASS + satchel nit landed, lance impact ACCEPTED.
replies.objection: Disclosed honest residuals, accepted as documented: midday within-screen value range still gentle (metric-bound); fog veil reads as one broad wash when sight fills the screen; deepnight value range compressed (leans on glows); selection rings/marquee + world-unit health bars still live in render.py (untouched by design — geometry/ownership frozen); victory-screen gap and hidden training-queue draw are frozen-geometry artifacts; mimo absent for the whole proposal (see dissent).

replies.evidence: Commit 301a1e3. Evidence: fps pairs vs clean-HEAD 61.84→59.08 / 61.38→60.33 / 57.21→55.01 (worst -2.76, bar -3); lattice 1.31→1.32 PASS; diff-probe fog alphas 0.00/~0.45/0.75-0.9; measured grass R-B +50 day → -2 deepnight; shake probe 267,949 px moved with camera restored; release_check 0/44; shots design/aaa-grade-{play,fog,night,deepnight,title,shake}.png.
replies.objection: Own disclosed residual: midday sun-wash range is gentle because stronger gradients are exactly what the lattice metric samples; base-heavy scenes make the veil read broad.

replies.evidence: Commit 07b9034. Evidence: hit-test action dumps across 21 states IDENTICAL to HEAD; fps 60.97→60.47 (-0.50, budget -2) with cached panels cheaper than the old per-frame allocations; campaign_probe --no-win ALL PASS; release_check 0/44; shots design/aaa-ui-{title,campaign,briefing,complete,hud}.png.
replies.objection: Own disclosed residuals: selection rings/world health bars not in ui.py; victory-screen 180px gap + queue draw-order are frozen geometry; tooltips kept dark walnut for contrast.

replies.evidence: Commits 2667756 + 1c97a7f. Evidence: full campaign_probe incl. mission-1 autoplay VICTORY (hall 1800/1800, necro 0, waves 0); fps 53.3→52.1 (-1.2, budget -2), +0.16ms (budget 0.6); release_check 0/44 first run; unscripted autoplay capture shows hooks firing in ordinary play; six design/aaa-vfx-*.png view-checked 2+ cycles each.
replies.objection: Own disclosed residuals: autoplay driver only ever casts Q (pre-existing; W/E/R need a scripted demo or a driver one-liner); dark orb in one capture proven to be prop art by disabling the VFX layer.

debates.claim: ROUND-1 REJECTION (real exchange): first fog pass feathered per-tile alpha but kept a one-tile SQUARE staircase with a big rectangular notch mid-right — feathering alpha does not fix the CONTOUR. Re-bar demanded: sub-tile interpolated mask, three nameable bands, re-shoot with the frontier diagonal.
debates.evidence: principal review of design/aaa-grade-fog.png round 1, 23:0x; recorded in session + lane's iteration log

debates.claim: REBUTTAL ACCEPTED AND PROVEN: mask rebuilt at 1/8 screen res with ISO DIAMOND texels (bounding boxes were the staircase), cloud-modulated, pre-blurred, smoothscaled → ~24px interpolated contour; objective diff-probe measures 0.00 → ~0.45 → 0.75-0.9 across the three zones; principal accepted round 2 (curved contour, zones nameable) and the lattice stayed 1.32 vs 1.31 baseline by easing the veil to 114 and raising within-cell texture.

PERF CONTENTION: chrome with grain+rivets+bevels on every panel looked like a guaranteed frame-loss against the -2 fps budget, and cached-per-size surfaces risk memory churn at 1600x900 with many panel sizes.
debates.evidence: budget set in lane brief; measured concern from the fps history of prior passes

debates.claim: REBUTTAL MEASURED: cached chrome is CHEAPER than what it replaced — the old panel() allocated fresh Surfaces per frame; clean same-conditions soak 60.97→60.47 (-0.50 fps, +0.14ms), and action-parity across 21 states proves zero interaction drift. The chrome paid for itself.
debates.evidence: lane report fps + parity dumps; release_check 0/44 at 07b9034
